cohort: The cohort consisted of 265 women undergoing C-sections recruited from multiple hospitals in Sindh, Pakistan.
finding: The study found a significant increase in PTSD scores from one to six weeks post-C-section, and a prolonged hospital stay (>5 days) was identified as a significant predictor of PTSD.
mod_finding: No significant difference in PTSD scores was found between women undergoing elective versus emergency C-sections at either one or six weeks post-surgery.
